mutations.because: the whole of one gate per worktree: with this check gone the acquire wins a slot, announces it on stdout and returns 0 while a live holder is gating the very tree it is standing in, so two verify-manifests runs mutate one worktree at once — the defect Qodo raised on gate-lock.sh:650. The test acquires for real from a git worktree root, so the holder's slot carries the worktree file try_create wrote, then acquires again from a SUBDIRECTORY of that same repository, which `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` resolves to the same root: it expects 75 and the words 'same worktree', and without the check the second acquire simply takes slot 1 and succeeds. Dropping the check is the only way this line can fail, so the claim is the whole block rather than any one line of it.
command: a second acquire in the same worktree is refused
